review.brief: Review tier 2 of RM67 on branch ft/RM67-MAG-73-vehicle-monthly-metrics-table. Code diff base: 2d4477c..HEAD (five commits: artifacts, wave 1, wave 2, wave 3, the verify record). Validate: (1) module-boundary compliance - internal/analytics must reach internal/charging only through public ports, never its db or internals; (2) every doc-pack convention, and the km/C/PSI display-unit and America/Bogota clock rules; (3) spec and tasks coverage - all 12 tasks, and nothing from the 'Not in this change' list was done; (4) the DB objects match the design the OWNER confirmed: the three cost columns must be NUMERIC(14,2) (RD11), and the copied capacity must keep TWO states, capacity_kwh plus capacity_measured, with no third column (RD12); (5) the integration tests assert the expected values design.md's Test Contract authored BEFORE the implementation, not whatever the code produces - this is the main anti-gaming check here; (6) Performance-Profile compliance; (7) no weakened criteria, no self-approved statuses, no edited task or contract text. Known leader concern to judge, not a blocker: db_monthly_sync_integration_test.go reuses tesla_id 555001 in three test functions. Safe today because none call t.Parallel() and each purges first; fragile if anyone adds t.Parallel(). SIGNALS: go build, go vet, gofmt -l, make lint, make naming-guard, make boundary-guard, make tz-guard, make archive-guard, make migration-boundary-guard, make tenancy-guard, make delta-guard, make vehicleref-guard were ASSISTANT-run and clean. The TEST SUITE was run by the OWNER, who reported all analytics tests passing. Judge test quality by READING the tests; do not run them.

findings.note: internal/analytics/mapping.go: pgNumericFromFloat64's comment is 9 lines for a 4-line function. Every sibling helper in this file (pgFloat8FromPtr, ptrIntFromPg, etc.) keeps its comment to 2-3 lines. Shorten it.

internal/analytics/db_monthly_sync_integration_test.go file header says 'every test below uses its own tesla_id', but T1, T3 and T6 all share tesla_id 555001 (matches design.md's Test Contract, so this is correct code -- only the header comment is wrong). Fix the sentence so a future reader does not add t.Parallel() trusting a false claim of full isolation.

rounds.notes: Reviewed diff 2d4477c..HEAD. Boundary clean, both owner-confirmed DB points honored (NUMERIC(14,2) costs, two-state capacity), all 12 tasks done, Not-in-this-change list respected, Test Contract T1-T6 and T-PURE-1-3 checked value by value against design.md and matched exactly. Shared tesla_id 555001 across T1/T3/T6 is safe today (no t.Parallel(), each test purges first) and is the design's own fixture choice, not a shortcut -- accepted, not a blocker.

decisions.decision: The copied capacity keeps two states, not three (roadmap RD12).
decisions.why: Owner accepted that 'no row' and 'thin month' both store capacity_measured=false.
